evidence.details: SessionManager owns AgentSession, AgentState, the exact TaskStateStore, per-session lock, generation, active task, cancellation source, compaction request, and revision. Ordinary opens create new sessions; active reuse requires explicit resume or continuous-taskset policy.

Cancellation advances generation before task cancellation; stale message, snapshot, domain projection, and final-result commits are rejected. Resume and environment rebind force observation authority to NEEDS_OBSERVE.

Immutable revision snapshots are fsynced before an atomic latest pointer, use expected-revision CAS plus thread/process file locks, skip orphan revision numbers without overwrite, recover only complete revisions, preserve canonical evidence refs, and exclude active resources.

TaskStatus transitions implement active/paused/terminal contracts with typed reject; every declared task_status is handled. Context is reprojected from the exact session store each iteration and compaction is an explicit session/generation value rather than shared assembler state.
